body.narrative:
Bank of America closed my account in relation to their deposit policy. However ; they stated they would mail me a cashier checks but did not state why my account was closed. 

The sum of money was rather substantial and they did not allow me to withdraw funds in person. This puts a strain financially on me and my family.

case.narrative: On XX/XX/2024 I transferred {$150000.00} to my XXXX bank account, I paid a fee of {$25.00} for a instant transfer. I checked my XXXX account, and the money was not there. As of XX/XX/2024, the money is still missing.

I received a payment from a client through Chime. I created an account so that I could access the money and transfer it to my bank account. This worked. However the next payment I could not transfer as Chime says they sent a physical card and this needs to be activated in order to transfer the money. I can not transfer or even refund the money. They refused to help me while on the phone and hung up on me. They are basically stealing peoples money.

I have a checking account with TD bank and another checking account with XXXX, I did transfer XXXX dollars ( twice ) on XXXX XXXX from my TD bank account to my XXXX checking account ( XXXX ) the first one was credited to my XXXX account, the second one was rejected, on XX/XX/XXXX but on XX/XX/XXXX ( without my authorization ) they took {$500.00} dollars from my TD bank via XXXX again but it doesn't reflect on my XXXX account, I did contact TD Bank, XXXX and XXXX but I didn't have answer

Popular Direct Bank misrepresents its savings account. They constantly introduced a new savings account with a higher interest rate than it was paying to existing customers of another account and that the mismatch was not clearly communicated, resulting in missing out on potential earnings. ( same issue as XXXX XXXX ).

warnings: Kemiripan dan respons historis bukan bukti keberhasilan penanganan. Kalibrasi eksploratif dan belum divalidasi manusia.
